### Fixed

- **Chat switching on Android.** After sending a message, opening another chat no longer hangs for up to half a minute.
- **DNS tunnel "Off" really turns the tunnel off.** It now stops the tunnel and removes its local proxy from every profile, so mail goes direct. Before, Off only changed routing and the proxy stayed, so a send could stall about a minute once it died. Installs already affected repair themselves on the next start.

### Changed

- Background fetch on Android is skipped while the app is open and gives up after 15 s instead of 30 s.

### Under the hood

- New core patch #17: the network-change call no longer holds the accounts lock while waiting, so chat-open requests aren't stuck behind a slow send. Chatmail core stays at 2.65.0; release builds compile the patched core.
- The DNS tunnel no longer logs "socks: EOF" for keepalive probes.
